label: v4 liquidity position client
summary: Plan a reviewed v4 pool and PositionManager client with exact ownership, fee collection, discovery and onchain reconciliation.
requiredFacts: Exact v4 SDK, SDK Core, PositionManager deployment, package integrity, release gitHead and chain binding
Canonical PoolKey and PoolId construction, native-currency handling, tick range, slippage, deadline and recipient
Position NFT owner, approval, fee beneficiary, removal, lock, migration, rescue and emergency-exit authority
Position-id discovery source and onchain reconciliation of ownership, pool, ticks, liquidity, nonce and approvals
Initialize, explicit mint, explicit increase, decrease, burn and zero-liquidity fee-collection behavior with final token balances
Current periphery prohibition on MINT_POSITION_FROM_DELTAS and INCREASE_LIQUIDITY_FROM_DELTAS plus final action-byte or trace verification
requiredFiles: Liquidity client source using public package-root imports
Position discovery and onchain reconciliation source
requiredTests: PoolKey sorting, PoolId derivation, native value, ERC-20 Permit2, refunds, deadlines and slippage
Mint and increase accounting including accrued-fee currency closure and actual final token requirements
Final action bytes and execution traces contain neither deprecated from-deltas liquidity action
Decrease, burn and collect-as-zero-liquidity-decrease with exact recipient and final balances
Indexer or subgraph omissions, stale ownership, reorgs, duplicate token ids and onchain reconciliation
Unauthorized approval, removal, migration, rescue, lock expiry, empty position and dependency outage
risks: PositionManager is not ERC721Enumerable, so an offchain discovery result can be incomplete or stale
Displayed principal changes can omit accrued fees or native and ERC-20 settlement effects
Deprecated from-deltas liquidity actions are sandwich-vulnerable because they lack minimum-liquidity protection
LP lock, ownership or fee-beneficiary claims can be false when removal, approval, rescue or migration authority remains
